selection_metric: validation log loss, lower is better

model_configs.RegularizedPoisson:
Pipeline(steps=[('simpleimputer',
                 SimpleImputer(add_indicator=True, keep_empty_features=True,
                               strategy='median')),
                ('standardscaler', StandardScaler()),
                ('poissonregressor',
                 PoissonRegressor(max_iter=500, tol=1e-07))])
model_configs.RandomForest:
Pipeline(steps=[('simpleimputer',
                 SimpleImputer(add_indicator=True, keep_empty_features=True,
                               strategy='median')),
                ('randomforestregressor',
                 RandomForestRegressor(max_depth=16, min_samples_leaf=10,
                                       n_estimators=200, n_jobs=2,
                                       random_state=42))])
model_configs.PoissonGradientBoosting:
HistGradientBoostingRegressor(early_stopping=False, l2_regularization=1.0,
                              learning_rate=0.05, loss='poisson', max_iter=200,
                              max_leaf_nodes=15, random_state=42)

metric_definitions.brier_score: mean sum over three classes of squared errors; range 0 to 2
metric_definitions.goal_mae: mean absolute goal error over both teams
metric_definitions.scoreline_nll: mean negative log probability of the observed goal pair
metric_definitions.exact_score_accuracy: fraction matching the independent-Poisson modal score pair

forecast_assumptions: Independent Poisson goals; recorded final goals may include extra time; no penalty-shootout goals.
probability_note: Raw model-derived probabilities; no post-fit calibration has been applied.
history_policy: Sequential forecasts: earlier validation/test results may update history before later fixtures. Model fitting remains restricted to the designated fitting period.

feature_schema.target_definition: Recorded final score, including extra time, excluding penalty shoot-outs
feature_schema.missing_values: Blank means unavailable. Fit any imputer and scaler on training rows only.
feature_schema.elo_expected_score_definition: Expected win/draw/loss score with win=1, draw=0.5, loss=0; not a home-win probability.
feature_schema.window_definition: Uses up to the specified number of prior appearances; an empty history is unavailable, not zero.
feature_schema.history_initialization: Begins at the first prepared match; no pre-1990 results are used by default.
feature_schema.same_date_policy: All features use strictly earlier calendar dates. All same-date ratings use the common pre-date state.
feature_schema.within_date_history_order: Deterministic match-ID order for subsequent rolling windows; kickoff order is unavailable.
feature_schema.evaluation_mode: Sequential forecasts: earlier validation/test results may update history before later fixtures. Model fitting remains restricted to the designated fitting period.
feature_schema.defaults_note: Engineering defaults fixed before model evaluation; tune using training/validation only.
feature_schema.is_friendly_definition: Tournament field equals Friendly, ignoring case.
